name: Animated Message Scheduler for Elementor (Lite Extended)
author: wplancer85

sections.description:
Animated Message Scheduler for Elementor (Lite Extended) lets you display dynamic messages using typewriting effects and powerful time-based controls:

🔥 Key Features in Lite Extended:

  • 🖋️ Display Modes: Normal or Typewriting animation
  • ⏰ Daily Scheduling: Set start/end hours and choose weekdays
  • 📅 Calendar Scheduling: Schedule messages based on start/end date and time
  • 🌍 Timezone Offset: Set GMT offset to control visibility across time zones
  • 🔗 Fallback Message & Link: Display an alternate message or URL if no schedule matches
  • 🧩 Elementor Integration: Seamless integration using a custom widget
  • 🧾 Shortcodes Supported:
    • [current_date format="d M Y"] – Current date
    • [current_time format="H:i" gmt="2"] – Current time with GMT offset
    • [latest_post_title_raw cat="category-slug"] – Latest post title and link from a selected category

👨‍💻 Ideal for: call-to-action buttons, marketing banners, dynamic headings, announcements, and landing pages.

🚀 Premium Features Available
Need glow/shadow effects, colorful typing, slide/fade transitions, or countdown timers? Try the Pro version here.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the animated-message-scheduler-for-elementor folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin via the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. In Elementor, locate the widget “Animated Message Scheduler for Elementor (Lite Extended)”.
  4. Drag it into your page and configure your scheduling options and effects.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Elementor Pro?

No. It only requires the free version of Elementor.

Can I use both daily and calendar-based scheduling?

Yes. You can add multiple intervals. The plugin will display the first matching one; otherwise, it shows a fallback message.

Can I use shortcodes in my messages?

Yes. You can use built-in shortcodes like [current_date], [current_time], or [latest_post_title_raw].
